notes: Phenomenology paper (Giannotti, Irastorza, Redondo, Ringwald, Saikawa 2017). It performs global fits to stellar cooling anomaly hints (WD luminosity function and pulsation periods, RGB tip, HB R-parameter, NS CAS A) in DFSZ and KSVZ-type axion/majoron models, yielding preferred (hint) regions around m_a ~ 10 meV, not exclusion limits. The exclusion bounds it uses (SN 1987A g_aN^2 < 3.6e-19, NS cooling g_an < 8e-10, hot-DM m_a < 0.8 eV) are adopted from cited earlier works, not newly derived. Figures 1-4 show hint contours plus projected sensitivities; Figure 5 and Appendix C give projections for the IAXO helioscope and the ARIADNE fifth-force experiment. Hence no new measured limit; the paper's forward-looking content is projections.
